title: The Sailor's Debt
description: Brennan owes the Guild a hundred and fifty and drinks it off at the Rusty Anchor. He had money a fortnight ago and will not say who gave it to him, only that the man buying was not the man paying. Collect, quietly.

objectives.description: Find the sailor Brennan at the Rusty Anchor tavern
Get the 150 gold out of Brennan
Return the gold to the Guild fence

notes: Soulstone-thread touchpoint per docs/design/quest_web.md row 11 (Tell 2): Brennan's unexplained money and the buyer who wasn't the payer. Never named, never explained, gates nothing. Touchpoint-only edit; rest of quest left as originally written (already STORIED).
